messages.subject: Re: Adjust hjust for SUBSET of tip labels
parts:
This is easy.  You can do something like this:

```
d = data.frame(label = tree$tip.label, adjust = 0)
d[your_subset, 'adjust'] <- a vector of numeric values
ggtree_plot %<+% d + geom_tiplab(aes(x = x + adjust))
```


On Wed, Apr 14, 2021 at 2:03 AM Molly Dawson <mddaws...@gmail.com> wrote:
Hi all,

I'm looking to adjust the hjust position for a SUBSET of my taxa/tip labels in my tree. How can I do this? Right now I'm using geom_tiplab and adjusting for hjust, but this gets applied to all of my tip labels. 

Is there a way to do this by specifying the tip label number of the tip labels I'm looking to adjust position for? For example, tree$tip.label gives me a number associated with each tip label. This seems so trivial but I can't find what I'm looking for on all of the gtree resources online. 

Best,

Molly
